data_mode: web (ESPN + BBC cached); no official player ratings, best/worst are Scout's pick
headline: Real Madrid trailed 0-1 at half-time with 4 shots, 0 on target and 0.25 xG to PSV's 8 shots and 1.49 xG; after a triple half-time change they had 20 shots, 9 on target, 4.55 xG and five goals, PSV 2 shots and 0.18 xG.

team_story.label: Shots by half (1st / 2nd)
team_story.why_it_matters: PSV out-shot Madrid two to one before the break; after it Madrid out-shot them ten to one
team_story.source: data/matches/psv-eindhoven-real-madrid-2026-11-24/shots_espn.json (count by minute <=45' incl. stoppage vs 46'+; analysis.py -> derived.json RMA_1st/RMA_2nd/PSV_1st/PSV_2nd; Scout calc from ESPN shot map https://www.espn.co.uk/football/match/_/gameId/401915298)

team_story.label: Shots on target by half (1st / 2nd)
team_story.why_it_matters: Madrid did not test Kovár once in the first half; all 9 of their shots on target came after the changes
team_story.source: shots_espn.json (outcome Saved or Goal, by half; derived.json); full-match 9 v 1 agrees with ESPN Team Stats 'Shots on Goal 9 (38%) / 1 (10%)' (data/research/scrape_2c7722c8d458.json) and BBC Match Stats 'Shots on target 9 / 1' (data/research/scrape_223bbed96be9.json)

team_story.label: xG by half (1st / 2nd)
team_story.why_it_matters: PSV had the better chances (incl. the 0.79 penalty) before half-time; Madrid's second half alone was worth 4.55 xG
team_story.source: shots_espn.json (sum of xg by half; derived.json). Shot-map total 4.80 / 1.67 vs ESPN team stat 4.79 / 1.69 (rounding)

team_story.label: Big chances created
team_story.why_it_matters: Madrid made eight clear chances and missed five of them, yet still scored five
team_story.source: data/research/scrape_2c7722c8d458.json (ESPN match page, Team Stats: Big Chances Created 8 / 3); data/research/scrape_cbbf3e8318b9.json (ESPN team stats, Attack: Big Chances Missed 5 / 3)

tactical_change.trigger: triple substitution at half-time while 0-1 down: Bellingham for Tchouaméni (booked 30'), Huijsen for Militão, Konaté for Rüdiger (booked 44')
tactical_change.effect: The second-half shift: Madrid went from 4 shots, 0 on target, 0.25 xG to 20 shots, 9 on target, 4.55 xG and 5 goals; PSV from 8 shots, 1.49 xG to 2 shots, 0.18 xG. BBC match momentum shows Madrid with the most threat in every minute from 47' to 73'.

evidence.label: Subs at half-time
evidence.source: data/research/scrape_223bbed96be9.json (BBC line-ups: 'J. Bellingham 46', substituted', 'Dean Huijsen 46'', 'I. Konaté 46''); ESPN match page Substitutions lists 45'

evidence.label: Manager's explanation (quote)
evidence.after: "We made changes, and Jude is a different player. He gives us what we didn't have in the first [half]." / "In the first half we didn't find our rhythm, we didn't press, we didn't win duels."

tactical_change.confidence: medium (subs and half split are hard data; no formation change, so the effect is a half-to-half shift, not a shape change)

best_player.name: Jude Bellingham
best_player.why: Scout's pick. Came on at half-time with Madrid 0-1 down and 0 shots on target; scored the 60' goal that put Madrid 2-1 up from a 0.03 xG shot (a 3% chance) and assisted Vinícius for the fifth. Mbappé had the bigger raw output (2 goals, 1 assist, 9 shots, 2.58 xG), so this is a judgement on impact, not volume.
best_player.source: data/research/scrape_e8fe8d8d8ee5.json (ESPN player stats, Bellingham row: TCH 53, G 1, A 1, xG 0.37, xA 0.17, SOG 2, SHOT 3); shots_espn.json shot n=19 (60', xg 0.03, Goal); BBC live text 'Vinícius Júnior ... Assisted by Jude Bellingham following a fast break' (data/research/scrape_223bbed96be9.json); BBC line-ups 46'

runner_up_player.name: Kylian Mbappé
runner_up_player.source: data/research/scrape_e8fe8d8d8ee5.json (ESPN player stats, Mbappé row: TCH 66, G 2, A 1, xG 2.58, xA 0.30, SOG 3, SHOT 9, BCC 2); ESPN match page Match Leaders '9 ... 3 SOG, 2.58 xG'

worst_player.name: Matej Kovár
worst_player.why: Scout's pick. Five goals conceded from shots worth 4.08 xG on target: 0.92 more than an average keeper would have let in (ESPN 'goals prevented'). Transparent score from the only per-player defensive measure available; his back line gave him little help in the second half.
worst_player.source: data/research/scrape_e8fe8d8d8ee5.json (ESPN player stats, PSV goalkeeper row: GA 5, SV 4, SOGA 9, xGC 4.79, xGOTC 4.08, GP -0.92)

surprise_stat.label: xG of Bellingham's goal (a 3% chance)
surprise_stat.context: The goal that put Madrid 2-1 up at 60' was the lowest-xG goal of the match, from distance (24 m on ESPN UK); Mbappé's two goals were 0.46 and 0.95.
surprise_stat.source: shots_espn.json (shot n=19 Bellingham 60' xg 0.03 Goal; n=21 Mbappé 64' 0.46; n=31 Mbappé 84' 0.95); distance from data/research/scrape_2c7722c8d458.json shot 19 of 34

table_context.fact: Real Madrid 5 wins from 5 in the league phase, 15 points, 1st; PSV 4 points, 28th (outside the top 24)
table_context.source: data/research/scrape_2c7722c8d458.json (ESPN UCL table: Real Madrid 5 5 0 0 +10 15; PSV 5 1 1 3 -5 4, 28th row); data/research/scrape_223bbed96be9.json (BBC: 'Real Madrid, Position 1, Points 15 / PSV, Position 28, Points 4'); ESPN story 'top of the league phase table with 15 points after winning all five UCL matches'

caveats: No official player ratings; best/worst are Scout's pick. BBC player-rating widget had not closed when cached (no fan averages).

Full-match xG disagrees: ESPN 4.79 / 1.69 (team stats, = shot-map sum) vs BBC/Opta 4.32 / 1.75 (ESPN commentary text also says 4.32 vs 1.69). No full-match xG used; half splits are from the ESPN shot map only.
Shots disagree: ESPN 24 / 10 vs BBC 22 / 10; possession ESPN 62 / 38 vs BBC 60.4 / 39.6. Shot counts by half are from the ESPN shot map (consistent with ESPN's 24 / 10); possession not used.
Half-time sub minute: ESPN 45', BBC 46'. Written as 'at half-time' / 46'.

Manager conflict: BBC line-ups list João Tralhão as Real Madrid manager; ESPN report and story say Mourinho made the changes and quote him (to Movistar). The quote is single-outlet; don't put a manager's name on screen without a second source.
Bellingham xG 0.37 on ESPN player stats vs 0.38 shot-map sum; Mbappé 2.58 vs 2.59. Player-stats figures used on player cards.
Bellingham played only the second half (45 min); best-player pick is about impact. Worst-player eligibility (45+ min) met by Kovár (90 min).
Firecrawl for analysis: 1 fallback search (2 credits) + 1 BBC match-page scrape (1 credit); ESPN player stats and ESPN story were free local fetches.
